title: Languages

---

How to write research software in one programming language. Each language gets
one document, which covers the language and its own tooling, such as its
package manager and environments, its test framework, its linters, and its
documentation tools. Planned are Python, R, SQL, and Bash.

A language document mixes rules and reference. Its rules, such as that every
user-facing function in Python has a docstring, carry the meaning of the
[normative language](../principles/design.qmd#sec-normative) of *Design
Principles*, and they apply its principles to the language: each rule cites
the principle it applies rather than restating it. The reference describes
what is useful to look up while working, such as the syntax of common
operations.
